title: Jackson Odumodu
text: I am from Woodstock, Ontario, and I studied Linguistics, Psychology, and Mathematics at the University of Toronto. I hope to gain technical skills from the Master of Data Science program, especially in working with machine learning. I am interested in machine translation, voice recognition, and also deep learning applications to finance.
